Are you going to stop me or are you going to chat? Poor partner of mine.

You can do whatever you want. I'm just going to warn you about one thing.

Okay, what do we do? Wait, come.
Alright, put all those things away. Wait, i haven't finished it, i haven't messed it up yet.

Put that away, please, now, please. Hurry up, hurry up.

Yes. And you always know how to motivate me.

Let's go, let's go. Come on, run.

No, wang junior. "chinito", although well, it's well applied to the demonym, but the diminutive, well, it offends.
The point is that we realized that life is too short to be putting brakes on ourselves. If i agree with her relationship, she has to agree with my girlfriend.
- oh. - right?

No, no, because i don't want to overwhelm her, but i plan to do it when the time is right. - good.

Get out. You should have stayed in your "choplayero" town, butcher.
- and you? Who do you think you are, huh?
You are nobody... More than the woman who has always wanted the man who loves me to love her.
Look at yourself. - look at me.
- (inés) uh-huh. You've had everything stretched, even your brain, man.
Actually, i do have class. - oh.

What else do you have, huh? That's how your life has always been.
You've never commanded respect. You always were...
And you'll always be the other woman. Nobody knows who you are.
Because aramis doesn't want to break the hearts of his daughters. He gives me my place.
He wants me to be comfortable. - oh, really?
- yes. And that's why you enter the hospital like this?
Who do you think is going to catch you, huh? Who do you think recognizes you?
They know my name. If i tell them who i am, they'll give me my place.
(laughs) (ines) what are you laughing at? You're also the other woman.
- oh, really? - yes, and i stayed with aramis when you left.
I am the woman of his life. Sofia and catalina already know about me.
They've already seen me, they've already shaken my hand. They know who i am.
Does that sound to you like i'm the other woman? Or does it sound like i'm the one who came to stay?
- (groans) - careful, careful. (hisses) you don't even come close.
How many identities do you have, huh? Aren't you that clown who's pretending to be the piano teacher, mmm?
Gina told me everything. You have much more to lose.
You want my man, inés? Go on.
Go with him. You need him much more than i do.
You are a horrible woman, candelaria, a mockery of a woman. Maybe.
But i'm much more interesting than you. I don't need a man to have a personality, inés.
If i were you, i'd think very carefully about what i'm going to do, because i'm very well trained. And could you beat me?
I'm taller. Surely much, much, much stronger.
You're too skinny, too scrawny. Even so, really, you come to threaten me?
You have everything to lose. They say that...
The more muscle, the slower. So i'll return the question.
Do you really think you can beat me? Your threats don't bother me.
I don't doubt it. If he wasn't afraid of me, he would have already punched me in the face.
- and what do i care about that? - you don't care?
Of course you care. Do you know what else would matter?
If i went to grecia's apartment and looked for her dna. Just in case...

Brother of a loser. Boyfriend of a mechanic.

Is that what you want? So you'd better consider my proposal.

Did you lack motivation? I'm not lacking desire.
Because of him, i know who i am. And i sold myself for men like you.
(laughs) look, we are in the same business, but we're not the same. I'm much better.
I do have reasons. Money?
Power? Hmm, i don't know if money, power, power or money.
No. Look, i really enjoy having money and having power, but no.
- no, it's not that. - love?
Of course, you look for women to dominate, because you could never have the one you wanted. Oh, so predictable, all men are the same.

- inés, inés. With us, you don't have to pretend.

Aramis is about to wake up. And i can't assure you he'll wake up in a good mood.
So drink this coffee... And then get out of the way as soon as you can.
I'm leaving. Like...

Look, you don't know and... You need to know that sofía and i are officially dating.

Wait, wait, wait. Okay, okay, let's see.

I'm going to ask you a question, really, i hope you'll be sensitive and tell me honestly what you think. At what age should a woman stop feeling desire?

Why is that wrong? Do you know why i had to do that?

And from what i see, you do too. No, well, no, no.
We are feminists. - yes, yes, 100%, mom.
- yes? Do you believe that?

Is this horrible what i'm saying? You think so, right?
Those who write think so. No, no, it's not like that.

What's wrong with that? I am free.
Or because we are of different social statuses? It seems to me that both could understand that that is not an impediment, right?
No, it's not that. The thing is, also...
I have the right to live my life because i am free, because i want to and because i can. And there are many people out there who feel the same way i do.
And surely someone who reads me thinks the same. And besides, it's good that they know they are not alone.
My love, besides, i am very proud of how you write. When i read it, i feel like i'm floating.
I love you with all my heart and i'm sure he loves you too. They are our daughters, they are our whole life.
But they have no right to tell us what we should comply with. Look, neither gonzalo nor gina are our partners anymore.
And we're not cheating on anyone. For god's sake, what's wrong with us loving each other?
I know it's not easy, but it hasn't been easy for you either. But desire doesn't die with age, huh?
And i want to be happy, i want to live and i want to experience my femininity every day of my life until i die. Mom, mom.
Please, forgive me. That's it.
Sorry, sorry, sorry, sorry. Yes, sorry, sofia, about the wedding.
Alright! Alright!
Defend yourself! I'm not going to defend myself, i'm not going to defend myself.
And if you want to hit me again, i'll be here. - why did you break my sister's heart, my niece's?
- it's the last thing i want to do. - well, but you did, didn't you?
You came into my house, you ate with my dad. And you hurt the person who loved you?
Who loves me. And i love her too.
Shut up, now. Yes?
Getting involved with grecia? The thing with grecia was a mistake, salvador.
Look, that can happen to anyone, even you. And you know it.
My little niece saw you as a father figure. And i see you as so pathetic.
I'm going to fix this. I swear it to you, with actions.
(phone ringing) (franco) brother. I need your help.
What do you need, brother? Oh, i thought you wouldn't wake up.
I was so worried about you. I found out what happened to you and...
I was... Worried.
What are you doing here? - if someone sees you...
- if someone sees me... It's about time you told them the truth.
Never. You will continue living in the shadows.
No one in my family should see you. Not now, not ever.
Have you forgotten that your only function... Is to make me feel good, and you don't see it.
I'll look for you when it's convenient. So if we follow that plan...

- let's see, let's see, what's next? - they're great.

I'm going to fix everything and... Oh, no!

- ani! A rag, please.
- there it is. - no, no, no, no, no, no, no.

Try it. Tell me about it.
Mmm... Uh-huh.
It's good, right? Yes, i liked it.
So there you have it. It's really good.

You and i, having a cool time, eating quesadillas. - what?

Obviously not. Look, i mean, i know that salvador is your boyfriend, but...
Rex, it's obvious we've been competing for him. And honestly, i don't want any of that anymore.
